## Checklist

- [ ] The design is agreed in an issue or on Discord (a new mod or a new feature only): #
- [ ] `pytest -m "not slow"` passes, and each new behaviour has a test.
- [ ] A new or changed mod: the version and a line in `src/dnfw/mods/history.py`.
- [ ] A new mod: `REGISTRY`, honest `extents`, `test/test_js_build_matches_cli.py`, the site entry and the README row.
- [ ] A change you can see: before and after images in this text, linked at the full commit SHA.
- [ ] Your own test on an instrument, if you made one: the `.syx` file name and what you tested.
- [ ] **Allow edits by maintainers** is ticked.
